title: Hospital visitation policy and extension of authority to reciprocal beneficiaries.
bodyText: A reciprocal beneficiary, as defined in chapter 572C, of a patient shall have the same rights as a spouse with respect to visitation and making health care decisions for the patient.
bodyHtml: [§323-2]  Hospital visitation policy and extension of authority to reciprocal beneficiaries.  A reciprocal beneficiary, as defined in chapter 572C, of a patient shall have the same rights as a spouse with respect to visitation and making health care decisions for the patient. [L 1997, c 383, §3]
